answer: A burned-ticket admission lottery stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch the registry holds one pulse draw for 100 slots: a ticket costs 10 credits, burned win or lose, and binds to one identity key. A forged ticket fails the key check and admits nobody. Ticket farming fails because each win admits only its bound identity: chasing 1,000 identities takes 10,000 tickets over ten epochs, burning 100,000 credits, and the k-th fake identity pays full price plus a rising share against honest entries. An honest agent buys one cedar ticket, risks 10 credits, and keeps its full slot when it wins.
